title: Excellent service - highly recommend - perfect spot to drop bags while you explore Barcelona
text:
Rating: ★★★★★

We used Luggage Storage Vault to store our luggage before our Airbnb check-in in Barcelona, and it was exactly what we needed. The location is fantastic – just a few minutes’ walk from the Sagrada Família, so it’s easy to reach and ideal if you’re starting your trip in that area.

From the moment we walked in, we felt reassured by how secure and well-monitored the place is. We were greeted immediately by their customer service team over an in-store intercom, which made it clear the facility is actively supervised.
